searchText: How can I go about implementing your light client spec tests as conformance tests <@881905303011086387> ? I don't see any test vectors in the consensus-spec-tests repo To generate the additional test vectors, from `consensus-specs`: ``` rm -rf ../consensus-spec-tests && doctoc specs && make lint && make gen_light_client ``` this will generate a directory `consensus-spec-tests` next to the `ethereum/consensus-specs` repo checkout generated them for you Oh wow... Thanks so much

excerpts.content: How can I go about implementing your light client spec tests as conformance tests <@881905303011086387> ?  I don't see any test vectors in the consensus-spec-tests repo

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content:
To generate the additional test vectors, from `consensus-specs`:
```
rm -rf ../consensus-spec-tests && doctoc specs && make lint && make gen_light_client
```

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content: this will generate a directory `consensus-spec-tests` next to the `ethereum/consensus-specs` repo checkout
